name: Dublin Mountains Way
description_md:
The Dublin Mountains Way is a waymarked hiking route in IE that covers 41.1 km. This trail is part of the national waymarked hiking network and is signposted as DMW.

The route involves 954 m of ascent and 1018 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The walking time is about 13 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
